# LUT color grading

Grades the image through a 3D lookup table, such as a `.cube` file exported from Resolve, Premiere or Photoshop, with tetrahedral interpolation. Four looks are built in.

<EffectDemo effect="lut" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { lut } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/lut';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(lut({ preset: 'tealOrange' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.lut = 'tealOrange'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                                                                    | Default        | Range | Description                                                                                                       |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lut`       | 3D texture or 'identity' \| 'tealOrange' \| 'warmFilm' \| 'coolNight' \| 'bleachBypass' | `'tealOrange'` |       | The LUT: a 3D texture (see createSampleTexture and parseCubeLut), the name of a built-in look, or null to bypass. |
| `intensity` | number                                                                                  | `1`            | 0 – 1 | Mix between the original and the graded image.                                                                    |
| `space`     | 'srgb' \| 'linear'                                                                      | `'srgb'`       |       | Whether the LUT expects display-encoded sRGB input (most .cube files) or linear values.                           |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset         | Settings                                 |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `tealOrange`   | `lut: 'tealOrange'`                      |
| `warmFilm`     | `lut: 'warmFilm'`                        |
| `coolNight`    | `lut: 'coolNight'`                       |
| `bleachBypass` | `lut: 'bleachBypass'`, `intensity: 0.85` |

Apply one with `lut({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/lut`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Adobe Cube LUT Specification 1.0; Kasson, Nin, Plouffe and Hafner, Performing color space conversions with three-dimensional linear interpolation, J. Electronic Imaging, 1995 (tetrahedral interpolation).
